title: Elixir of Heroism

sources.title: Elixir of Heroism
markers: * Gain {{temp hp|10}} and a {{DieIcon|d4|Slashing}} '''1d4''' bonus to {{Attack Roll}}s and {{SavingThrow}}s until the next long rest.

sources.title: Elixirs
markers: Only one elixir can be applied at a time

summary: Drink as a Bonus Action. Gain 10 temporary HP and +1d4 to attack rolls and saving throws until the next Long Rest.

fields.Drink: Bonus Action. Consume one bottle. Gain 10 temporary HP and +1d4 to attack rolls and saving throws until the next Long Rest.
fields.Stacking: Replaces another elixir effect. Drinking a different elixir can end this effect early. Unspent temporary HP can remain after replacing the elixir.
fields.Creative use: Drink before a fight where this effect will matter.
fields.Crafting: Combine Sublimate of Pegasus Feathers with any Ashes.
fields.Base value: 30 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
fields.Bless interaction: The elixir’s +1d4 bonus stacks with Bless.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 activation, effects and linked rules.
